source: Curated from official U.S. Department of State Visa Bulletin employment-based tables (public-domain U.S. government works). Seed months are machine-readable reconstructions of travel.state.gov HTML archives; always verify against the official bulletin.

notes.cutoffEncoding: null = C (Current); "U" = Unavailable; ISO YYYY-MM-DD = cut-off date
notes.tables: A = Final Action Dates; B = Dates for Filing. These are separate historical series.
notes.uscisAosChart: Optional per-bulletin field from USCIS Adjustment of Status filing-chart guidance (which DOS chart AOS filers should use that month). Independent of Table A/B history. Values: "A", "B", or null if unknown/not scraped.
notes.categories: EB-1..EB-5 map to 1st..5th Unreserved preference rows (Other Workers and EB-5 set-asides omitted in MVP)
notes.chargeabilities: ROW = All Chargeability Areas Except Those Listed
notes.updates: Monthly GitHub Action scrapes new DOS bulletins (and optionally USCIS chart page) — see .github/workflows/update-visa-bulletin.yml

backfill.source: Parsed from DOS Visa Bulletin HTML mirrors (travel.state.gov pages cached under vyakunin/visa_bulletin saved_pages). Official URLs recorded in each bulletin.sourceUrl. Live travel.state.gov fetch was Cloudflare-blocked and Internet Archive was temporarily offline during this backfill.
